title: SCORE READS IN SP, NOT DOLLARS
why: His order of 2026-10-15: it was confusing that the score was shown in dollars when it does not match the loot value, and maybe score should just be SP, score points. Every score figure now reads N SP: the score tile on the HUD, the rows of the run card ledger (kills, medals, goals, bounty, strongholds, vaults, upgrades, the raid score), medal and kill popups, the forge costs, the run goals, the demo scoreboard and RUN OVER card, and the leaderboard SCORE column. Money stays money: the credits banked, the haul value, the raid total and the credits line on the raid plate keep the dollar sign. A point of score still banks as one credit on an extraction.
now: Score now reads in SP (score points) everywhere; credits and loot value stay in dollars.
